'''Johnston''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a gunnery [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was stationed aboard the [[Justice (Harrower-class)|''Justice'']], and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the elite [[Republic Special Forces Division]] unit [[Havoc Squad]] when he confronted them during their infiltration of the ship.
